admissionPolicy.zh: 候选记录不是正式收录。只有权威来源、许可与再分发、完整契约、传输协议、安全审查以及 SDK/CLI 发布六个门槛全部通过并建立完整分级产品目录后，slug 才可进入 catalog/products.json。完整产品边界包含尚未按该供应商真实语义完成契约和运行验证的 SSE、WebSocket 或其他实时协议时，整集暂缓，不得裁剪发布。
admissionPolicy.en: Candidate records are not catalog admission. A slug may enter catalog/products.json only after authoritative sourcing, redistribution, complete-contract, transport, safety, and SDK/CLI publication gates all pass and a complete isolated product directory exists. If the complete product boundary contains SSE, WebSocket, or another realtime protocol that has not been contracted and runtime-validated with the provider's actual semantics, the whole collection is deferred rather than published as a subset.
